openings.claim: Separate lateral registration from seal compression: two removable padded, bolted strip-pair assemblies grip the rim and locate hatch edges. Transfer sideways load from hatch-to-seal friction to edge-to-strip-to-rim bearing; avoid tightening the left corner. Cord retains released components.
openings.discriminator: Against stronger compression-only retention, locating faces should reduce sideways displacement without reproducing opposite-corner lift. This is hypothetical; adequate bearing capacity and disturbance tolerance remain unestablished.
openings.probe: First check actual rim access, edge geometry, strip reach, padded engagement and complete clearance on removal. Only if feasible within ninety fabrication minutes, make one configuration using four supplied strips, bolts, pads and cord; drill/cut only strips. Within twenty observation minutes, run ten opening/closure/20 N pull trials; place the supplied 1 mm card at the marked right contact for final closure. Record marked-position error, pull movement, corner lift, reopening time and seal tears each cycle. Clear every assembly from the full opening when open. Reject any outcome failure, engagement slip, permanent deformation or seal damage; stop before apparent damage.
openings.uncertainty: Indispensable interface geometry is unspecified. Pad/bolt/strip grip and bearing capacity without permanent fixture deformation are assumed. Disturbed closure remaining within 1 mm and reopening within 30 seconds without increased corner compression is assumed, not established.

lineage.reason: Retains causal load-path change, compression rival, full challenge and defeat tests, resource/stopping caveats, assumptions and declared uncertain fit.

decision: Retain one feasibility probe, not deployment. Preserve existing hatch, rim and seal: no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation; no powered mechanism; recoverable loose components; full opening clearance; no new visible seal tears. Require ten-cycle position within 1 mm, resistance to 20 N and one-technician reopening within 30 seconds. Disturbance exempts only seal-contact continuity. Ten trials respect the twelve-trial cap; unsuitable engagement defeats the probe without relaxing constraints.
